dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Mondstadt's poetry really is a world apart from Natlan's. It's so soft and delicate.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Listening to it is almost like... being enveloped in a gentle breeze.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I guess the only question is... what it all actually means, haha...
